segments.text: Most of us encounter chemicals in one form or another every day.
segments.zh: 我们大多数人每天都会以这样或那样的形式接触到化学品。

segments.text: They're used in a wide range of products and laboratory processes, and are often essential
segments.zh: 它们被用于各种各样的产品和实验室流程中，而且往往是

segments.text: in our jobs.
segments.zh: 我们工作中必不可少的。

segments.text: But if we don't take the proper precautions, many chemicals can be hazardous to our safety
segments.zh: 但如果我们不采取适当的预防措施，许多化学品就可能危害我们的安全

segments.text: and health.
segments.zh: 和健康。

segments.text: There are many types of potentially hazardous chemicals, flammables, corrosives, irritants,
segments.zh: 潜在危险化学品有很多类型：易燃物、腐蚀性物质、刺激物、

segments.text: sensitizers, toxins, even carcinogens, which can cause cancer.
segments.zh: 致敏物、毒物，甚至还有会致癌的致癌物。

segments.text: Each of these chemicals has its own set of hazards, required safety precautions, and recommended
segments.zh: 每一种化学品都有各自的危害、必需的安全防范措施以及建议的

segments.text: emergency procedures.
segments.zh: 应急程序。

segments.text: So how can we work with hazardous chemicals safely?
segments.zh: 那么，我们怎样才能安全地使用危险化学品呢？

segments.text: How should we handle and store them?
segments.zh: 我们应该如何搬运和储存它们？

segments.text: What personal protective equipment should we use?
segments.zh: 我们应该使用哪些个人防护装备？

segments.text: And what should we do in an emergency?
segments.zh: 在紧急情况下我们又该怎么做？

segments.text: For years, material safety data sheets, MSDSs, provided us with the answers to these questions.
segments.zh: 多年来，物质安全数据表，也就是 MSDS，为我们提供了这些问题的答案。

segments.text: MSDSs came about as part of OSHA's Hazard Communication Standard.
segments.zh: MSDS 是 OSHA 危害沟通标准的一部分。

segments.text: This right-to-know regulation required chemical manufacturers and importers to give their customers
segments.zh: 这项知情权法规要求化学品制造商和进口商，向客户提供

segments.text: MSDSs for any potentially hazardous products that they supplied.
segments.zh: 他们所供应的任何潜在危险产品的 MSDS。

segments.text: But although certain types of information had to be included, OSHA did not require a standard
segments.zh: 但是，虽然某些类型的信息必须包含在内，OSHA 并没有要求物质安全数据表

segments.text: format for material safety data sheets.
segments.zh: 采用统一的格式。

segments.text: As a result, MSDSs ended up in a variety of forms, with data arranged in different ways.
segments.zh: 结果，MSDS 形式五花八门，数据的编排方式也各不相同。

segments.text: This often made it hard to find the information that you needed.
segments.zh: 这常常让人很难找到所需的信息。

segments.text: And in an emergency situation, this could cost valuable time.
segments.zh: 而在紧急情况下，这可能会耽误宝贵的时间。

segments.text: Another difficulty with many material safety data sheets was that they were written in
segments.zh: 许多物质安全数据表的另一个难题是，它们是用

segments.text: technical language, as if they were intended only for health and safety professionals.
segments.zh: 专业术语写的，好像只是写给健康与安全专业人员看的。

segments.text: However, many other types of people, such as firefighters, emergency medical technicians,
segments.zh: 然而，许多其他类型的人，比如消防员、急救医疗技术员，

segments.text: and laboratory workers like you, also need to be able to understand what MSDSs tell them.
segments.zh: 以及像你这样的实验室工作人员，也需要能够看懂 MSDS 告诉他们的内容。

segments.text: To address these problems, OSHA has adopted the Globally Harmonized System of Classification
segments.zh: 为解决这些问题，OSHA 已将《全球化学品统一分类

segments.text: and Labeling of Chemicals, GHS for short, into the HASCOM standard.
segments.zh: 和标签制度》，简称 GHS，纳入危害沟通标准。

segments.text: The GHS was developed by the United Nations so that workers anywhere in the world would
segments.zh: GHS 是由联合国制定的，目的是让世界上任何地方的工作人员

segments.text: be able to understand the hazards that a chemical presents.
segments.zh: 都能够理解一种化学品所带来的危害。

segments.text: A major part of the Globally Harmonized System is the use of the GHS Safety Data Sheet.
segments.zh: 全球统一制度的一个重要组成部分，是使用 GHS 安全技术说明书。

segments.text: It gives chemical manufacturers a standard format and specific, understandable language to use
segments.zh: 它为化学品制造商提供了统一的格式，以及具体易懂的语言，

segments.text: to describe a chemical's hazards.
segments.zh: 用来描述化学品的危害。

segments.text: Although compliance with the GHS is voluntary, most industrialized countries are adopting it
segments.zh: 虽然遵循 GHS 是自愿的，但大多数工业化国家都在采用它，

segments.text: and will be starting to use GHS Safety Data Sheets soon, if they haven't already.
segments.zh: 而且如果还没有用的话，很快也将开始使用 GHS 安全技术说明书。

segments.text: So it also makes it easier for U.S. chemical companies to sell their products internationally.
segments.zh: 所以它也让美国化学品公司更容易在国际上销售产品。

segments.text: For many workers, the GHS Safety Data Sheet will look very familiar.
segments.zh: 对许多工作人员来说，GHS 安全技术说明书看起来会非常眼熟。

segments.text: That's because it's formatted almost exactly like one of the versions of the ANSI Material
segments.zh: 这是因为它的格式几乎和 ANSI 物质安全数据表的某个版本

segments.text: Safety Data Sheet, except for much of the information in Sections 2 and 3, whose
segments.zh: 一模一样，只是第 2 部分和第 3 部分中的大部分信息

segments.text: positions are swapped.
segments.zh: 位置互换了。

segments.text: Although just like ANSI MSDS's, GHS Safety Data Sheets present information in an as-needed
segments.zh: 不过，和 ANSI MSDS 一样，GHS 安全技术说明书也是按需要的先后

segments.text: order.
segments.zh: 顺序来呈现信息的。

segments.text: The chemical's identity, its hazards and some emergency instructions are provided up front
segments.zh: 化学品的标识、危害以及一些应急说明放在最前面，

segments.text: for quick and easy access.
segments.zh: 便于快速查阅。

segments.text: Basic safety information is presented next in easy-to-understand language.
segments.zh: 接下来用通俗易懂的语言介绍基本安全信息。

segments.text: Supporting technical data, as well as information for health and safety professionals is provided
segments.zh: 辅助性的技术数据，以及供健康与安全专业人员使用的信息，放在

segments.text: later in the SDS.
segments.zh: 安全技术说明书的后面。

segments.text: Safety Data Sheets are designed to answer four basic questions that anyone who encounters
segments.zh: 安全技术说明书旨在回答任何接触化学品的人可能有的

segments.text: a chemical might have.
segments.zh: 四个基本问题。

segments.text: What is the material and what are its hazards?
segments.zh: 这是什么物质，它有哪些危害？

segments.text: What should I do if a problem occurs when I'm working with this material?
segments.zh: 如果我在使用这种物质时出了问题，我该怎么做？

segments.text: What precautions should I take to prevent problems when I work with this material?
segments.zh: 使用这种物质时，我应该采取哪些预防措施来防止出问题？

segments.text: And finally, is there anything else I should know about this material?
segments.zh: 最后，关于这种物质，还有什么我应该知道的吗？

segments.text: Each of these questions is answered by one or more sections of the Safety Data Sheet.
segments.zh: 每个问题都由安全技术说明书的一个或多个部分来回答。

segments.text: For example, Sections 1, 2 and 3 provide answers to the first question, what is the material
segments.zh: 例如，第 1、2、3 部分回答第一个问题：这是什么物质，

segments.text: and what are its hazards?
segments.zh: 它有哪些危害？

segments.text: Section 1 of the SDS identifies the material using the standard GHS product identifier.
segments.zh: 安全技术说明书的第 1 部分使用标准的 GHS 产品标识符来标识该物质。

segments.text: You'll find the same product identifier on both the SDS and the chemical's container label.
segments.zh: 你会在安全技术说明书和化学品的容器标签上看到相同的产品标识符。

segments.text: Section 1 also lists the name, address and telephone number of the chemical's manufacturer,
segments.zh: 第 1 部分还列出了化学品制造商、进口商或经销商的

segments.text: importer or distributor.
segments.zh: 名称、地址和电话号码。

segments.text: This is provided in case you have questions about the SDS or the material itself.
segments.zh: 这是为了方便你对安全技术说明书或物质本身有疑问时联系。

segments.text: An emergency telephone number may also be listed for quick access to additional information.
segments.zh: 还可能列出一个应急电话号码，以便快速获取更多信息。

segments.text: Section 2 describes the hazards that are associated with the chemical, including the
segments.zh: 第 2 部分描述与该化学品相关的危害，包括

segments.text: information that's provided on the chemical's label, such as the signal word, hazard statements
segments.zh: 化学品标签上提供的信息，比如信号词、危险说明

segments.text: and precautionary statements.
segments.zh: 和防范说明。

segments.text: It may also contain copies of the GHS pictograms that appear on the label.
segments.zh: 它还可能包含标签上出现的 GHS 象形图。

segments.text: Section 3 discusses the ingredients in the chemical and its composition.
segments.zh: 第 3 部分介绍化学品中的成分及其组成。

segments.text: It also provides additional identifying information such as its chemical identity, common name
segments.zh: 它还提供其他标识信息，比如它的化学名称、通用名称，

segments.text: and CAS and EC numbers.
segments.zh: 以及 CAS 号和 EC 号。

segments.text: The next important question that a safety data sheet answers is, what should I do if a problem
segments.zh: 安全技术说明书回答的下一个重要问题是：如果我在使用这种物质时

segments.text: occurs when I'm working with this material?
segments.zh: 出了问题，我该怎么做？

segments.text: Sections 4, 5 and 6 provide this information.
segments.zh: 第 4、5、6 部分提供这方面的信息。

segments.text: Section 4 of the SDS outlines the basic first aid measures that can be used before professional
segments.zh: 安全技术说明书的第 4 部分概述了在获得专业医疗救助之前

segments.text: medical assistance is available.
segments.zh: 可以采取的基本急救措施。

segments.text: Simple instructions are provided based on the chemical's route of exposure.
segments.zh: 根据化学品的暴露途径，给出简单的说明。

segments.text: For example, first aid instructions for skin contact might be, remove contaminated clothing,
segments.zh: 例如，皮肤接触的急救说明可能是：脱去被污染的衣物，

segments.text: wash skin with soap and water, get medical attention.
segments.zh: 用肥皂和水清洗皮肤，就医。

segments.text: If the material gets into your eyes, you might be instructed to immediately flush eyes with
segments.zh: 如果这种物质进入眼睛，可能会指示你立即用

segments.text: plenty of water for at least 15 minutes.
segments.zh: 大量清水冲洗眼睛至少 15 分钟。

segments.text: Get immediate medical attention.
segments.zh: 立即就医。

segments.text: This section also provides information on the symptoms and effects the chemical can produce
segments.zh: 这一部分还提供该化学品可能引起的症状和影响的信息，

segments.text: to help you recognize if someone has been exposed.
segments.zh: 帮助你识别是否有人受到了暴露。

segments.text: You can see why it's important to know the appropriate first aid measures before you
segments.zh: 你可以看出，在使用危险物质之前了解相应的急救措施

segments.text: work with a hazardous material, so be sure to read Section 4 of the SDS immediately for
segments.zh: 为什么很重要，所以对于你要使用的任何化学品，

segments.text: any chemical that you are going to use.
segments.zh: 一定要立即阅读安全技术说明书的第 4 部分。

segments.text: You should also know the location of first aid kits, safety showers and eye washes in
segments.zh: 你还应该知道工作区域内急救箱、紧急喷淋和洗眼器

segments.text: your work area.
segments.zh: 的位置。

segments.text: Section 5 of a GHS safety data sheet provides information, precautions and instructions for
segments.zh: GHS 安全技术说明书的第 5 部分提供扑救涉及该物质的火灾

segments.text: fighting fires that involve the material.
segments.zh: 所需的信息、注意事项和说明。

segments.text: This section includes information on any hazards that the material could present if it burns.
segments.zh: 这一部分包括该物质燃烧时可能带来的任何危害的信息。

segments.text: For instance, a fire could release poisonous fumes that are more dangerous than the material
segments.zh: 例如，火灾可能会释放出比物质本身

segments.text: itself.
segments.zh: 更危险的有毒烟气。

segments.text: Appropriate extinguishing media to use when fighting a fire involving the chemical is also
segments.zh: 这一部分还指明了扑救涉及该化学品的火灾时

segments.text: identified in this section.
segments.zh: 应使用的合适灭火介质。

segments.text: This may include water, water fog, foam, carbon dioxide, halon and other dry chemicals.
segments.zh: 其中可能包括水、水雾、泡沫、二氧化碳、哈龙以及其他干粉灭火剂。

segments.text: Using the wrong type could make a bad situation even worse.
segments.zh: 用错类型可能会让糟糕的情况变得更糟。

segments.text: Firefighting instructions describing basic strategies that minimize the hazards the material
segments.zh: 这里还提供灭火说明，描述能尽量减少该物质在火灾中

segments.text: may present any fire are also provided here.
segments.zh: 可能带来的危害的基本策略。

segments.text: The personal protective equipment necessary for firefighting will be listed in this
segments.zh: 灭火所需的个人防护装备也会列在这一

segments.text: section as well.
segments.zh: 部分。

segments.text: This usually includes the full firefighting gear and an SCBA, self-contained breathing
segments.zh: 这通常包括全套消防装备和 SCBA，即自给式空气

segments.text: apparatus.
segments.zh: 呼吸器。

segments.text: Even more protection may be necessary for some hazardous chemicals.
segments.zh: 对于某些危险化学品，可能还需要更多的防护。

segments.text: Section 6 tells you what to do in case of spills, leaks and other accidental releases
segments.zh: 第 6 部分告诉你在发生危险物质溅洒、泄漏和其他意外释放时

segments.text: of hazardous materials.
segments.zh: 该怎么做。

segments.text: Included in this section are general procedures for containing a spill or other accidental
segments.zh: 这一部分包括一般程序，用于控制溅洒或其他意外

segments.text: release, cleaning up the hazardous material and decontaminating clothing and equipment that
segments.zh: 释放、清理危险物质，以及对接触过该物质的衣物和设备

segments.text: comes in contact with the material.
segments.zh: 进行去污。

segments.text: To review, SDS sections 4, 5 and 6 provide information on what to do if a hazardous situation
segments.zh: 回顾一下，安全技术说明书第 4、5、6 部分提供的是发生危险情况时

segments.text: occurs.
segments.zh: 该怎么做的信息。

segments.text: The next question the Safety Data Sheet addresses is what precautions can I take to prevent
segments.zh: 安全技术说明书要回答的下一个问题是：使用这种物质时，我可以采取哪些预防措施

segments.text: problems when I work with this material?
segments.zh: 来防止出问题？

segments.text: For answers, we turn to sections 7, 8, 9 and 10.
segments.zh: 要找答案，我们就看第 7、8、9、10 部分。

segments.text: Section 7 covers handling and storage practices that will minimize the physical and health
segments.zh: 第 7 部分介绍搬运和储存方面的做法，这些做法能尽量减少该物质的物理危害和健康

segments.text: hazards of the material as well as preserve its quality.
segments.zh: 危害，并保持其质量。

segments.text: As you would expect, the handling instructions on the SDS are often the same as the ones
segments.zh: 正如你所料，安全技术说明书上的操作说明往往与

segments.text: listed on the chemicals container label.
segments.zh: 化学品容器标签上列出的相同。

segments.text: For example, in this section you might see the caution, avoid contact with eyes, skin
segments.zh: 例如，在这一部分你可能会看到这样的警示：避免接触眼睛、皮肤

segments.text: and clothing, ensure that containers are properly secured before moving.
segments.zh: 和衣物，搬运前确保容器已妥善固定。

segments.text: This section also provides information on the appropriate storage conditions for the material
segments.zh: 这一部分还提供该物质及其容器的适当储存条件信息，

segments.text: and its container including temperature, humidity, atmospheric pressure, ventilation, vibration
segments.zh: 包括温度、湿度、大气压力、通风、所在区域的

segments.text: in the area and exposure to light.
segments.zh: 振动以及光照。

segments.text: Depending on the material, these may all be relevant factors for safe storage and
segments.zh: 根据物质的不同，这些都可能是安全储存和

segments.text: maintaining product quality.
segments.zh: 保持产品质量的相关因素。

segments.text: Engineering controls, personal protective equipment and exposure guidelines are addressed
segments.zh: 工程控制、个人防护装备和接触限值指南

segments.text: in section 8 of the SDS.
segments.zh: 在安全技术说明书的第 8 部分中介绍。

segments.text: Engineering controls might include things such as the use of local exhaust ventilation
segments.zh: 工程控制可能包括在使用某些物质时

segments.text: systems when working with some materials.
segments.zh: 使用局部排风系统之类的措施。

segments.text: Other materials may require fully enclosed systems where no release of gases or vapors
segments.zh: 其他物质可能需要完全封闭的系统，不允许

segments.text: can be permitted.
segments.zh: 任何气体或蒸气释放。

segments.text: This section also lists the personal protective equipment necessary to minimize the risk of
segments.zh: 这一部分还列出了将暴露风险降到最低所需的个人防护

segments.text: exposure.
segments.zh: 装备。

segments.text: For example, to provide respiratory protection, the SDS may instruct you to wear a NIOSH approved
segments.zh: 例如，为提供呼吸防护，安全技术说明书可能会指示你佩戴经 NIOSH 认证的、

segments.text: air purifying respirator equipped with organic vapor cartridges or canisters.
segments.zh: 装有有机蒸气滤盒或滤罐的空气净化式呼吸器。

segments.text: For eye protection, you may be directed to wear safety glasses with side shields or
segments.zh: 对于眼部防护，可能会要求你佩戴带侧护板的安全眼镜或

segments.text: safety goggles.
segments.zh: 安全护目镜。

segments.text: To defend against skin contact, rubber gloves and other protective clothing might be recommended.
segments.zh: 为防止皮肤接触，可能会建议使用橡胶手套和其他防护服。

segments.text: Section 8 of the SDS will also list any TLVs, threshold limit values, PELs, permissible
segments.zh: 安全技术说明书的第 8 部分还会列出任何 TLV，即阈限值，PEL，即容许

segments.text: exposure limits or other established exposure guidelines for the material or its hazardous
segments.zh: 接触限值，或其他既定的接触限值指南，针对该物质或其危险

segments.text: ingredients.
segments.zh: 成分。

segments.text: This information is used by your employer to determine the engineering controls and
segments.zh: 你的雇主会利用这些信息，来确定适合你所做工作的工程控制和

segments.text: personal protection appropriate for the work you do.
segments.zh: 个人防护。

segments.text: Section 9 of the SDS describes the physical and chemical properties of the chemical.
segments.zh: 安全技术说明书的第 9 部分描述该化学品的物理和化学性质。

segments.text: This information is important for evaluating the use of a material for a specific purpose
segments.zh: 这些信息对于评估一种物质是否适合特定用途很重要，

segments.text: and can help to determine what precautions should be taken when working with a chemical.
segments.zh: 并能帮助确定使用该化学品时应采取哪些预防措施。

segments.text: Your employer will also use the chemical and physical characteristics listed in this
segments.zh: 你的雇主还会利用这一部分列出的化学和物理特性，

segments.text: section to help determine the safest work practices for your facility.
segments.zh: 来帮助确定你们设施最安全的作业方法。

segments.text: The information can be helpful in identifying a chemical when its container label has been
segments.zh: 当化学品的容器标签损坏或毁坏时，这些信息

segments.text: damaged or destroyed as well.
segments.zh: 也有助于识别该化学品。

segments.text: Estability and reactivity is also information that is needed to determine safe handling,
segments.zh: 稳定性和反应性也是确定安全搬运、

segments.text: storage, transportation and disposal procedures.
segments.zh: 储存、运输和处置程序所需的信息。

segments.text: For this data, we turn to section 10 of the SDS.
segments.zh: 这些数据，我们要看安全技术说明书的第 10 部分。

segments.text: This section will indicate whether the material is chemically stable or dangerously unstable
segments.zh: 这一部分会说明该物质是化学稳定的，还是危险地不稳定的，

segments.text: under normal conditions.
segments.zh: 在正常条件下。

segments.text: It will also describe conditions to avoid when working with a material such as heat,
segments.zh: 它还会描述使用该物质时应避免的条件，比如可能导致危险情况的

segments.text: pressure, shock or other physical stresses that might result in a hazardous situation.
segments.zh: 热、压力、冲击或其他物理应力。

segments.text: If the material might react with another substance to create a hazardous situation such
segments.zh: 如果该物质可能与另一种物质发生反应，造成诸如

segments.text: as poisonous vapors, a fire or an explosion, this incompatibility will be listed as well.
segments.zh: 有毒蒸气、火灾或爆炸之类的危险情况，这种不相容性也会被列出。

segments.text: This section of the SDS also addresses any hazards that could be produced as a result
segments.zh: 安全技术说明书的这一部分还涉及由

segments.text: of oxidation, heating, decomposition, polymerization or other chemical reactions.
segments.zh: 氧化、加热、分解、聚合或其他化学反应可能产生的任何危害。

segments.text: Remember, sections 7, 8, 9 and 10 provide the information necessary to prevent hazardous
segments.zh: 记住，第 7、8、9、10 部分提供了防止危险

segments.text: situations from occurring.
segments.zh: 情况发生所需的信息。

segments.text: This brings us to the fourth question the GHS Safety Data Sheet is designed to answer.
segments.zh: 这就引出了 GHS 安全技术说明书要回答的第四个问题：

segments.text: Is there anything else I should know about this material?
segments.zh: 关于这种物质，还有什么我应该知道的吗？

segments.text: This information can be found in sections 11 through 16.
segments.zh: 这些信息可以在第 11 至 16 部分找到。

segments.text: Most workers use this information under the guidance of health and safety professionals
segments.zh: 大多数工作人员是在健康与安全专业人员的指导下使用这些信息的，

segments.text: such as industrial hygienists, environmental managers and safety directors.
segments.zh: 比如职业卫生师、环境经理和安全总监。

segments.text: However, your employer may also use these sections as a reference when setting up your
segments.zh: 不过，你的雇主在制定你们

segments.text: company's standard operating procedures.
segments.zh: 公司的标准操作规程时，也可能会把这些部分作为参考。

segments.text: So you might want to take a quick look at this information.
segments.zh: 所以你可能需要快速浏览一下这些信息。

segments.text: Section 11, toxicological information, provides background toxicity information on the health
segments.zh: 第 11 部分，毒理学信息，提供有关该物质健康危害的

segments.text: hazards of the material.
segments.zh: 毒性背景资料。

segments.text: This includes likely roots of exposure, symptoms related to the chemical's toxicological characteristics
segments.zh: 这包括可能的暴露途径、与化学品毒理学特性相关的症状，

segments.text: and immediate and delayed effects of exposure.
segments.zh: 以及暴露的即时和迟发效应。

segments.text: Section 12, ecological information, addresses the effects that the material may have on
segments.zh: 第 12 部分，生态学信息，介绍该物质可能对

segments.text: plants, wildlife and other aspects of the environment.
segments.zh: 植物、野生动物和环境的其他方面造成的影响。

segments.text: Section 13, disposal considerations, provides information on safe and proper waste management
segments.zh: 第 13 部分，废弃处置，提供安全、正确的废物管理

segments.text: options.
segments.zh: 方案信息。

segments.text: Section 14, transport information, includes the chemical's UN number, proper shipping
segments.zh: 第 14 部分，运输信息，包括该化学品的联合国编号、正式运输

segments.text: name, transport hazard classes, packing group and any special precautions that should be
segments.zh: 名称、运输危险类别、包装类别，以及运输该化学品时应采取的

segments.text: taken when transporting the chemical.
segments.zh: 任何特殊预防措施。

segments.text: Section 15, regulatory information, addresses any federal, state and international regulations
segments.zh: 第 15 部分，法规信息，介绍可能适用于该物质的任何联邦、州和国际

segments.text: that may apply to the material.
segments.zh: 法规。

segments.text: Section 16 contains other relevant information that doesn't belong in any of the previous
segments.zh: 第 16 部分包含不属于前面任何部分的其他相关信息，

segments.text: sections as well as information on preparing and revising the SDS.
segments.zh: 以及有关安全技术说明书编制和修订的信息。

segments.text: There's a lot we need to know about the chemicals we work with, and safety data
segments.zh: 关于我们所使用的化学品，有很多需要了解的东西，而安全技术

segments.text: sheets are where to go to find it.
segments.zh: 说明书就是查找这些信息的地方。

segments.text: Let's review.
segments.zh: 我们来回顾一下。

segments.text: GHS safety data sheets provide information about the chemicals you work with.
segments.zh: GHS 安全技术说明书提供你所使用化学品的相关信息。

segments.text: SDSs are organized much like an ANSI-MSDS and contain much of the same type of information.
segments.zh: 安全技术说明书的编排与 ANSI-MSDS 非常相似，包含的信息类型也大致相同。

segments.text: The information in an SDS is presented in an as-needed order.
segments.zh: 安全技术说明书中的信息按需要的先后顺序呈现。

segments.text: Some of the information from an SDS also appears on a chemical's container label.
segments.zh: 安全技术说明书中的部分信息也会出现在化学品的容器标签上。

segments.text: GHS safety data sheets are a valuable tool for working with hazardous chemicals, and
segments.zh: GHS 安全技术说明书是使用危险化学品的宝贵工具，

segments.text: understanding them will help you to do your job safely.
segments.zh: 理解它们将帮助你安全地完成工作。

segments.text: So make sure you know where the SDSs are in your laboratory, and read them before you
segments.zh: 所以一定要知道安全技术说明书在你们实验室的什么地方，并在你

segments.text: use any chemicals that you work with.
segments.zh: 使用任何化学品之前阅读它们。
